profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Skilled Software Engineer with 20 years experience in the successful design, development, and testing of software systems as both a team lead and individual contributor.  Strong technical leadership and real-time debugging skills.  Committed to creating top quality products, detail oriented with the ability to complete multiple tasks on time.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Avaya Learning
positions.description:
•	Developed software for the Learning Management System software enabling students to register, attend, and track their training.
•	Designed and developed reporting tool that detailed the virtual campus training offers the student had accessed and how long they accessed the training.
•	Designed and developed ASP.NET Web Application showing what instructors were available in the Virtual Office and there areas of expertise.
•	Worked with PHP, Java, C++, C#, SQL Server 2008, MYSQL, Javascript, HTML, AJAX, JSON, CSS, and ASP.NET MVC.

positions.title: Software Engineer - AvayaLive Engage
positions.description:
•	Developed C++ software using Visual Studio for the 3D Spatial Audio Engine used in the 3D virtual world to make users feel like they are there in person.
•	Designed features and bug fixes for immersive 3D collaborative web application.
•	Developed analytics tracking software for gathering students participation data and providing a real time metrics HUD to the instructor
•	Used agile development methodology with rapid prototyping in a small team 
•	Worked with UnrealScript, C++, C#, HTML, JavaScript, Java, AJAX, and JSON

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed flight critical embedded real-time software for multiple missions.  I developed software for LynxOS, Integrity, and VxWorks operating systems.  The software varied from low level drivers and board support packages to the higher level flight applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed embedded software for the F22 Encryption System, CDMA Handset, Iridium handset and speakerphone, and Public Safety Emergency Radio Systems.
